paragraphs.text: Harcu was a mercenary on Shandalar who was hired to bring back a chest containing the key to the Onakke Catacombs .

As Harcu and his associates were discussing the best way to bring the chest back to the Onakke Catacombs , Liliana Vess interrupted them by kicking the door down and barging in. She planned to hire the mercenaries to break into the viceroy's palace. Liliana planned for the mercenaries to handle the viceroy's guards while she killed him. Harcu did not believe her and raised his sword to attack Liliana. However, an angel on the hunt for the band of mercenaries swooped in. As Harcu charged toward Liliana, the angel filled his body with golden light until he disintegrated, to the shock of everyone in the room.
